The internet has a way of turning the most harmless moments into psychological warfare, and this cat is living proof. 😭

The therapist said, “There is a tiger in you,” expecting some deep conversation about inner strength. Meanwhile, the tiger in question looks like it just discovered the front-facing camera at 3 AM.

What makes this so good is the absolute mismatch between the inspirational quote and the cat's expression. For a second, your brain expects a powerful transformation, but instead gets a tiny orange menace with its tongue out.

This is where it stops being a meme and starts becoming ancient internet mythology. Future philosophers will analyze this image as evidence that every human has an inner beast, and sometimes that beast has absolutely zero brain cells.

Bro went to therapy to find his inner strength and unlocked a Walmart tiger with Wi-Fi. 🐅💀
